body_hi:
सभी पुण्यआत्माओं को मेरा नमस्कार---
अभी हाल की स्थिती में मुझे रोसा महसुस हो रहा है, की वर्तमान समय अनेक स्थानों पर आश्रमों में "श्री गुरुशक्तीधाम का निमाण" कार्य चल रहा है और पर्याप्त धन की भी आवश्यकता सभी जगह है, और उसके लीये धन संग्रह के भी प्रयास सभी जगह चल ही रहे हैं, लेकीन सभी प्रयास "राकांकी" चल रहे हैं, क्षेत्रीय साधक केवल अपने क्षेत्र के ही गुरुशक्तीधाम का क्षेत्रीय विचार रख कर चल रहे हैं, जबकी यह विचार व प्रयास सामुहीकता

(2)
में और "गुरुतत्व" के नेतृत्व में हो तो मुझे लगता है, हमारे प्रयास अधीक सफल सिध्द होंगे। सभी ही गुरुशक्तीधाम हमारे अपने ही हैं, क्योकी क्षेत्रीयता का विचार त्यागकर हम ही अपने आप को "सामुहीक शक्ती" से दूर कर रहे हैं।
सभी गुरुशक्तीधाम का "बांधकाम" वास्तव में तो गुरुशक्तीयों की "स्थापना" ही है, और जहां सामुहीकता है, वहां गुरुशक्तीयां होनी ही हैं, इसलीये हमें धन संग्रह के लीये भी सामुहीकता में प्रयास करना चाहीये "प्रत्येक साधक का योगदान प्रत्येक ही श्री गुरुशक्तीधाम के निर्माण कार्य में होना चाहीये।" रोसा विशाल दृष्टीकोण रखकर एक संकल्पधारी योजना प्रारंभ की जा रही है, योजना इस प्रकार है।

(3)
इस योजना से आप बड़ी सामुहीकता में जुडले हैं, तो "8-11-2025" तक सारे ही श्री गुरुशक्तीधाम का बांधकाम पुर्ण हो सकता है, बांधकाम में भी मेरा "प्रोजेक्ट 1" है, जीसमें निये का गादीध्यान व उसमे विस्खचत्र की स्थापना व उपर का गर्भगृ व शिखर तक का कार्य व सामने दर्शन के नीचे कमलेकम 20 फीट का हॉल इतना मेरी योजना में प्रोजेक्ट 1 में है। बाकी समरत कार्य प्रोजेक्ट 2 में हो सकता है, प्रोजेक्ट 1 भी महत्वपूर्ण है, गादीध्यान व उसमे विस्खचत्र की स्थापना कर उसे उपर के गर्भगृह की मंगल मुर्ती के साथ जोड़ना अतीआवश्यक है, और यह शरीर स्वास्थ्य व क्रियाशिल होना भी नक

(4)
हो सकता है, इस लीये आप सभी का सहयोग "तीन साल" के लीये आवश्यक है, आप इसमें अपना योगदान देकर आनेवाली पिढ़ीयों को आत्मसाक्षात्कार का मार्ग दिखा रहे हैं, "आत्मसाक्षात्कार के दान से अधीक कोई भी दान नहीं है।"
मासीक संकल्प की राशी इस प्रकार से है, "81 Rs", "2025 Rs", "81125 Rs" आप चाहे तो एक साल का या तीन साल का दान राशी साथ भी दे सकते हैं, आप आपके संकल्पपत्र अपने आचार्यो से सेन्टर से प्रभारव आचार्ये से लेकर मेरे पास मेरे "निजधाम ऑफीस" में भेज सकते हैं, इस ऑफीस में फोन पर वॉट्सएप मेसेज से श्री पवन काकानी जी

(5)
से संपर्क कर सकते हैं, वे ही ऑफीस के मेनेजर हैं, आप संकल्पत्र से अपने मित्रों व रिश्तेदारों को भी इस योजना से जोड़ सकते हैं।
हमारा "इरादा" एक ही आपके जीवनकाल में बनरहे सारे गुरुशक्तीधामों में आपका "योगदान" हो, आप संकल्पकर अपनी इच्छा व्यक्त करें तो आप अनुभव करेंगे आपकी इच्छा गुरुशक्तियां आपको ही माध्यम बनाकर पुर्ण कर लेंगी।
हमारे जीवनकाल में हो रहे इस इस पाक कार्य में आप सभी सहयोग करें, "आप सभी को खुब खुब आशीर्वाद।"

आपका अपना
बाबा स्वामी
5|10|2022
body_en:
My Salutations to all Pious Souls....

Today is the Eighth (Ashtami) day of Navratri. On this day, the Mother Goddess (Mataji) manifests in many women and these women start dancing and making a lot of expressive faces. Different people ask them various questions too; and they also reply to them. Many people pray to these women to get their work done; and they solve a lot of people's problems too. Some people have also got these experiences, and some people believe in them too. Usually, these are only women, but sometimes, these can be men too. In Maharashtra, this is also called blowing the clay pot (ghaghar phunkna), being energised by the Mother Goddesses' energy; they (these women) keep walking, while holding a clay pot in their hands, and keep blowing smoke from it.

Now, many people have a question, is it that the Goddess or Mata (Mother) really manifests in them? And later on, these women suddenly become absolutely normal, and they don't remember anything that they had said, or what they had done. This used to happen to one of my maternal cousins too. She was married with children; she had a big family. Generally, she would say that during the three days of her menstrual cycle, the Mataji would not enter her body, or she would enter her body on days other than the three days of her menstrual cycle. On Ashtami day, someone or the other from the house would

(2)
always accompany her. In the evening, she would take a bath, become fresh and leave for aarti and then she would go around visiting various temples while dancing all along till midnight. The temples too were pre-decided. If you asked her at midnight, she would not remember anything. Whatever she replied would also be correct. Whenever she solved someone's problem, then later people would also come home to give her gifts; at that time, she would not remember anything about what she had said, how the problem had got solved.

Then, I myself would remind her that you had given this solution to this person; then she would say, don't pay too much attention to that, it just happens; in reality, I don't do anything.

[NOTE: A soul can provide everything other than self-realisation, because it has not received that (self-realisation) itself. The proximity of a dead (person's) soul is not good.]

In Maharashtra there is a Konkanastha Brahmin caste; in their house after auspicious rituals take place, a programme of worshipping a Goddess named Bodan takes place. My (cousin) sister would be called for that too, and the Mother Goddess's energy would enter into her during that puja also.

Now, let us understand about what used to happen here. During the days of my spiritual practice, I had to travel to the Himalayas via Assam. In Assam, there are two such villages - Kaamroop and Naugaon - where there was a group of occultists and sorcerers (mantriks-tantriks). There itself, once after a shibir, a Thakur sahab came to meet me. His age was more than 100 years, and he was given a lot of

(3)
respect in that area. He had attained a lot of spiritual powers - he had solved a lot of people's problems. Because of this, he was accepted as a Guru in society. He was very humble. He came to me, and said that - I have performed penance for several years on an island in the centre of the Brahmaputra River, so that I could get spiritual powers, and later on I got these powers too.

I used those powers for social service, to awaken people, to alleviate sadness-pain in people's lives, and I have been doing this continuously for the past several years. But after meeting you, I felt that now I am already old, and that I should do something for myself in the declining/sunset period of my life. It is my wish, that you bestow me with self-realisation, so that I can spend the remaining part of my life in attaining inner knowledge, and finally attaining liberation. I told him that he would have to pay the price for this. One doesn't get anything for free; one thinks that it is free, but it is the rule of life, that there is nothing that is free.

It appears to sadhaks and sadhikas that they are obtaining self-realisation for free through my medium; they think so, because I don't take any fees or money from them; but the sadhaks or sadhikas don't always get self-realisation for free. Their bad karmas of the past birth have to be destroyed; so along with them, their meritorious karma also get destroyed, meaning, that they get self-realisation at the cost of their meritorious karma. By destroying everything of the past birth, and after the sadhak comes into the present time, self-realisation is attained; so how is self-realisation free? Now, the sadhaks obtain self-realisation at the cost of the meritorious deeds of their past birth. And even after obtaining this invaluable self-realisation,

(4)
it can be called the misfortune of the sadhak/sadhika, if he/she does not attain the karma-free state by not doing his/her spiritual practice, what else?

The sadhak's state becomes such as if he/she had a bank draft (banker's cheque), which was also encashed, and he/she spent the cash also which was obtained through it on useless things. Now, neither the draft remains nor the cash! Self-realisation too is a spiritual experience which one gets after several births. Other than self-realisation, human beings have nothing that has to be obtained from outside; and after attaining self-realisation, everything has to be obtained from within by becoming introversive.

I explained to Thakur Sahab that if you wish to obtain self-realisation, then you will have to give up your spiritual powers (siddhis); and you are respected in society only because of these spiritual powers.

He replied immediately - I have done a lot for society and for my relatives, now I want to do something for my own self. Later, I bestowed self-realisation on him, and then all his spiritual powers had gone away; and the reason for that was that these spiritual powers were not his at all. He had performed spiritual practice to obtain spiritual powers, and some benevolent souls who had obtained spiritual powers during their lifetime, but who could not put them to use for social service during their lifetime - those souls were fulfilling these desires through the medium of Thakur Sahab's body. This was because Thakur Sahab had a physical body, and those souls had spiritual powers; with Thakur Sahab's self-realisation, these souls too became free, because

(5)
their desire of doing social service by using their spiritual powers had been fulfilled.

Hence, I keep telling my sadhaks who are practising spirituality, don't meditate for obtaining spiritual powers, else those souls who have obtained spiritual powers may enter your body. You should meditate solely and only to become empty; also, don't meditate with the expectation of obtaining liberation, because this too is an expectation. One's spiritual practice cannot reach a high state with this expectation. Just meditate because you feel good, then you yourself will become empty. You yourself will not realise when you have reached the karma-free state. One does not have to attain a state of moksha (liberation); when one's body consciousness reduces on obtaining everything, only then is that state of moksha obtained.

By narrating Thakur Sahab's incident, what I want to say is, that the Goddess or the mother does not come, it is some benevolent soul which comes. But these benevolent souls generally come into only those women who wish to get respect in society, and they are not getting this respect at home. It was the same with my sister. She was rich, she had a big family, but everyone at home were busy in their own work. She did not get respect, so she used to get respect when souls came (into her) in the form of Mata.

All souls are not bad, there are some good souls too; but souls, meaning, that because the souls of the past entered (her body), my sister had become weak. She died quickly too because the souls had used her body. This is one experience of my life, which I remembered during the eighth day (Ashtami) itself. I felt that it would be good to

(6)
share it with you. You have obtained self-realisation by paying the price of your meritorious deeds of their past birth. And even you have to feel it, that's all, what else!

Lots of blessings to all of you.

Your own
Baba Swami
3|10|2022
